resources.string: Tip through Google Play to keep it that way →
Dish, Satellite, and every Dish client are free, open source, ad-free, and analytics-free. No paywalled features, no upsells, and no plans for any of that. Tips are what keep them true.
Tip the developer through Google Play, once or monthly.
Pick an amount. Google Play handles the payment and the receipt. A tip unlocks nothing; Dish stays the same for everyone.
Renews every month at the price shown until you cancel. Cancel any time in Google Play under Payments and subscriptions.
Pick a different amount to change your plan. The change is prorated by Google Play.
You support Dish every month. Thank you.
